detail: No pre-existing implementation of observation-digest-v1 was registered, and no mature open-source package provides this exact fixture-to-digest contract, so one bounded authoring step produced a dependency-free Node procedure at procedures/observation-digest-v1.js under the mission artifact root. It independently reads the JSON observation fixture, validates each row, sums scheduled/completed/incidents over all rows, groups the same sums by site, and computes completion_percent as completed/scheduled*100 rounded half-up to exactly 2 decimals using exact BigInt integer arithmetic (round(completed*10000/scheduled) hundredths) so no binary floating-point drift is possible; it persists digest.json and digest.md into the fixed output directory argument. Probe run against input/pilot.observations.json in an isolated probe directory yielded row_count=3, scheduled=30, completed=26, incidents=6, completion_percent=86.67 with sites North (rows 2, 22/18/5, 81.82) and South (rows 1, 8/8/1, 100.00). Those totals were confirmed by an independent Python decimal recomputation from the raw fixture rather than trusted from the procedure's own stdout. Boundary and failure tests passed: 1/32 rounds to 3.13 (half-up, not banker's 3.12), a zero-scheduled fixture yields 0.00 without dividing by zero, non-integer input exits 2 with no output written, and two repeat runs produced byte-identical digests. The proposed target itself was not executed at the final fixed output path during acquisition; the probe output above is evidence only and carries no capability/status/detail/local_target fields. Runtime /usr/bin/node is v22.23.3; no packages installed, no network use, no host or config changes.
